stories.title: Anthropic prepares IPO with potential $1.4 trillion valuation
stories.summary: Anthropic is preparing an initial public offering that could be among the largest ever, with a projected market valuation of about $1.4 trillion. The company cites strong demand for its Claude AI models, rapid revenue growth, and backing from major technology firms as the main drivers of the planned listing. The IPO is presented as a notable event for the global AI sector.
stories.why: The offering could bring significant capital to the AI industry and influence investor sentiment in technology markets.

stories.title: US stocks rise as CoreWeave earnings lift AI trade
stories.summary: Wall Street opened higher after CoreWeave reported robust earnings, with the Dow Jones up 27.13 points (0.05%), the S&P 500 up 73.02 points (0.97%) and the Nasdaq up 385.17 points (1.54%). The gains were seen as a counterbalance to concerns about rising AI spending.
stories.why: Positive AI‑related earnings helped improve market sentiment.

stories.title: Google unveils TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max chips
stories.summary: Google announced two new variants of its eighth‑generation Tensor Processing Units, the TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max. The TPU 8tx, designed with AMD, adds hardware‑level security that keeps data and model weights protected during training and inference and includes a custom inference network that can distill and train small models on the fly, allowing work on proprietary data without moving it. The TPU 8i Max combines two TPU 8i chips into a single package, doubling memory capacity, compute power and bandwidth, enabling larger models to handle more information per query.
stories.why: The chips let Google Cloud customers run sensitive AI workloads and larger models while reducing dependence on external chip suppliers.
stories.previousTitle: Google broadens its AI hardware portfolio with two new specialized chips
stories.previousSummary: Google is notching up its chipmaking game as the company seeks to reduce its dependence on chips made by other companies for its cloud computing business. Google on Monday unveiled two new variants of its tensor processing units (TPUs), in-house-developed chips meant for AI workloads, that broaden its chip portfolio to additional use cases: confidential inference and more memory capacity for large workloads.

stories.title: OpenAI, Anthropic face new oversight as New York’s AI safety law takes effect
stories.summary: The state opened a registration portal Tuesday, with which large frontier AI developers like Anthropic and OpenAI will be required to register by January 1, 2027. It mandates that large frontier developers — companies with more than $500 million in annual revenue — have to publish safety frameworks on their websites, report critical safety incidents within 72 hours, and issue public model transparency reports.
stories.why: This matters because it could change AI capabilities, costs, adoption, regulation or competitive positioning.

stories.title: India on track to achieve $1 trillion export target by FY27, says commerce minister
stories.summary: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal said India is on track to meet its $1 trillion goods and services export target for fiscal year 2027, after recording nearly $480 billion in exports from April to September. He cited opportunities from free‑trade agreements, especially the proposed India‑EU pact, for the automobile and mobility sectors, and urged manufacturers to expand globally, improve competitiveness and use international partnerships.
stories.why: Trade developments can affect currencies, business costs, market access and the external balance of the economies involved.
